verdict.rationale: Kimi is a consumer AI assistant, so official iOS and Android apps are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents a desktop app, a CLI, editor integrations, a browser extension and the web app at kimi.com, but nothing about mobile apps for either platform. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android
